intro: Prospector Remtravel is a dwarven archaeologist affiliated with the Explorers' League, stationed deep in the gloomy woodlands of Darkshore. He oversees an excavation site unearthing ancient relics, though his scattered focus and perilous surroundings leave him in constant need of assistance.

sections.t: A Dwarven Dig in Elven Lands
p: Sent far across the sea by the Explorers' League, Prospector Remtravel established his dig site along the southern reaches of Darkshore. While the night elves are often protective of their ancestral territories, the League's insatiable drive to uncover the origins of Azeroth pushes prospectors into every forgotten corner. Remtravel's work unearths fossilized history and ancient stones, but the aggressive native wildlife and hostile local threats make managing a frontier dig almost more than one scatterbrained dwarf can handle.
